rationale: capex = system_size_kw_dc * (hard_cost_usd_per_kw + sum(component_cost * scenario_multiplier)); LCOE = (capex*capital_recovery_factor + fixed_om_usd_per_kw_year*system_size_kw_dc) / annual_energy_mwh_year1. Quantiles use empirical linear interpolation across the five scenario LCOEs; expected value is the arithmetic mean.
